title: All About Me
communicative_goal: Say age, feelings, likes; present a simple 'about me' card.
unit_end_capability: Learner can say name, age, a feeling, and one like.

lessons.target_language: I am ___ years old. / How old are you?
lessons.objective: Ask and say ages with birthday-cake visuals.
Express basic feelings with face cards and buddy check.
State likes and dislikes with picture choice.

lessons.target_language: I'm ___. I'm ___ years old. I'm ___. I like ___.
lessons.objective: Build a personal 'about me' card with recycled language.

lessons.target_language: Hi, I'm ___. I'm ___ years old. I like ___.
lessons.objective: Present the about-me card to a partner / class.
